notes.title: PlayTest Has concluded
notes.notes: thank you all so much for joining the playtest of Slov Survival. I really appreciate your time and feedback, and I hope you had a great time playing the game. Your input is incredibly valuable to me as a developer, and it will help me make the game even better for everyone. Please don't hesitate to reach out to me if you have any additional feedback or ideas you'd like to share. Thanks again for being a part of this process, and I hope to see you all again soon for the next playtest!
